title: Four Women in Red
description: Four identical women with long black hair wear flowing red gowns with gold trim. Three stand on the left casting green energy tendrils and red sparks from their hands, while the fourth sits barefoot on a blue chaise lounge holding a lit candle that emits golden sparks. The stone room has an arched window showing a cracked icy landscape at sunset.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene inside a stone room with an arched window overlooking a cracked icy sea at sunset. Four identical women with long flowing black hair wear elegant off-shoulder red gowns with gold trim. Three stand dynamically on the left casting swirling green energy tendrils and red lightning from raised hands, black soot and golden embers cover the floor around them. The fourth woman sits barefoot on a royal blue chaise lounge on the right, holding a lit candle that sparks golden light. Dramatic swirling patterns, detailed fabric and hair, mystical atmosphere.
